faq_heading: Homes near Newton Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Newton Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Newton Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Newton Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Newton Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 67 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,149,000, townhomes $793,750, condos $521,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Newton Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Newton Elementary the median was 21 days on the market, closing at 98.8% of the list price, with 30% of sales above the list price for the 67 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Newton Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Guru Angad Dev School (0.9 km south), Bear Creek Elementary (0.9 km east) and Sikh Academy (1.2 km north-west).

Newton Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 13359 81 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Newton Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Newton Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Newton Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Newton Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 67 homes sold within 1 km of Newton Elementary: 10 houses, 22 townhomes and 28 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $521,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Newton Elementary

34 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Newton Elementary in a straight line (20 elementary, 10 secondary, 4 other; 5 independent). The closest is Guru Angad Dev School, 0.9 km away, and the farthest on this list is SD 36 Education Services (Type 1), 2.7 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Bear Creek Elementary (0.9 km); the nearest secondary school is Frank Hurt Secondary (1.5 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Simon Cunningham Elementary (2.9 km). Other elementary schools close by: Bear Creek Elementary (0.9 km east), Surrey Muslim School (1.3 km south), Dr F D Sinclair Elementary (1.7 km south-west), Cindrich Elementary (1.8 km north), Brookside Elementary (2.0 km north-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Bear Creek Elementary, 0.9 km east of Newton Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Newton Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Newton Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Go past Newton Elementary on a school morning and again mid-afternoon to see the traffic, parking and noise before you offer.
Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median condo within 1 km of Newton Elementary was $521,500, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Bear Creek Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.9 km east of Newton Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
